projection_vs_immediate.rationale: The split is driven by whether a read can be wrong without raising an error. S4 (.length on non-array -> undefined > 0 === false) and the S3 discriminant literal (inequality) are silent-wrong-behavior reads, so a projection carries a wrong answer forward faithfully. S2 is a signature change with no shim. S8 and S9 throw at plugin load, so a projection cannot suppress them.
